sentences.text: Kamala Devi Harris -LRB- -LSB- ˈkɑːmələ -RSB- born October 20 , 1964 -RRB- is an American attorney and politician who is the junior United States Senator from California .	California	California	junior	Seniority in the United States Senate	United States Senator	United States Senator

She is a member of the Democratic Party and served as the 32nd Attorney General of California .	California	California	32nd	List of Attorneys General of California	Attorney General of California	Attorney General of California	Democratic Party	Democratic Party (United States)	32nd Attorney General of California	List of Attorneys General of California
Harris graduated from Howard University and University of California , Hastings College of the Law .	California	California	Howard University	Howard University
She worked as a Deputy District Attorney in Alameda County , California -LRB- 1990 -- 98 -RRB- .	California	California	Deputy District Attorney	District Attorney	District Attorney	District Attorney

She served as Managing Attorney of the Career Criminal Unit in the San Francisco District Attorney 's Office -LRB- 1998-2000 -RRB- and as Chief of the Community and Neighborhood Division in the office of San Francisco City Attorney -LRB- 2000 -- 03 -RRB- .	San Francisco City Attorney	City Attorney of San Francisco	District Attorney	District Attorney	San Francisco	San Francisco

In 2003 , she was elected as California 's first African American female District Attorney of San Francisco , defeating incumbent Terence Hallinan .	District Attorney of San Francisco	San Francisco District Attorney's Office	Terence Hallinan	Terence Hallinan	California	California	African American	African American	District Attorney	District Attorney	San Francisco	San Francisco
She was re-elected in 2007 and served from 2004 to 2011 .
Harris was elected California 's Attorney General in 2010 and re-elected in 2014 .	California	California	re-elected in 2014	California Attorney General election, 2014

Harris was the first woman , the first Jamaican American , the first Asian American , the first Indian American , and the first African American attorney general in California . On November 8 , 2016 , she defeated Loretta Sanchez in the 2016 U.S. Senate election to replace outgoing Democratic senator Barbara Boxer , becoming the third woman of color , first Indian American , and first biracial woman -LRB- alongside Tammy Duckworth and Catherine Cortez Masto -RRB- elected to serve in the United States Senate .
